research_question: Can an evaluator-owned UI-only adapter reproduce the official API ui payload exactly at the same fixed states while eliminating vision encoding and frame-file side effects?

api_source.getAgentObservation: renders viewport, writes PNGs, encodes two vision PNGs, then calls ui.renderJSON and updates taskProgress/steps
api_source.renderJSON: returns the same ui payload but pops one extended message from its queue; comparison therefore uses separate identically initialized processes

alternatives.reason: agent-compatible but generates/encodes vision and writes frame files at every observation
removes disk writes but still renders and base64-encodes vision; does not prove UI-only semantic parity
renderJSON pops extended-message queue; sequential calls at one state can perturb comparison
identically seeded/process-isolated worlds each consume one UI read per state; compare canonical UI hashes step-by-step
changes third-party runtime and violates current research-only/native-pause boundary

selected_design.controlled_frame_directory: unique per cell; measure before cleanup

primary_endpoints: 20/20 official-to-ui_only ordered canonical UI hash vectors are exact at observations 0-1000
10/10 UI-only same-seed repeat ordered UI hash vectors are exact
all 30 cells are valid_complete with exact manifest identity, exit 0, counters 1..1001, 1000 successful action/tick transitions and pinned source identities
source-mirrored UI side-effect fingerprints match official mode for the allowlisted state fields
official cells produce exactly 1002 PNG files in isolated temporary directories; UI-only cells produce zero
secondary_endpoints: official frame bytes per cell before cleanup
message queue 0/1/2 and dialog sentinel fixture results
falsifiers: any official-to-ui_only ordered UI hash vector mismatch
any invalid, timeout, crash, malformed or unobservable cell
any allowlisted post-observation state fingerprint mismatch
any UI-only frame or vision key
lifecycle: approval binds exact run ID, proposal/design/adapter/upstream/interpreter/closure hashes and canonical result/marker/ledger/sidecar paths
preflight rehashes actual interpreter and closures, archives exact committed DiscoveryWorld source, verifies clean source HEAD/tree, and executes snapshot through PYTHONPATH
O_EXCL marker consumes approval before cell 1; existing marker/result/ledger/sidecar blocks with zero launches
cell PLANNED is fsynced before spawn; raw stdout/stderr binary sidecars and terminal cell status are fsynced before next cell
managed process groups enforce per-cell timeout and global deadline; controller-integrity failure stops later launches
result uses temp file fsync, atomic rename and directory fsync; marker is never removed
scope_limits: a PASS admits source-mirrored adapter only for the pinned fixed ROTATE_DIRECTION/tick public-UI projection across two named families/seeds 0-4
it does not establish arbitrary action, dialog, inventory-changing, task-solving, visual, scorer, gold or full internal-state equivalence
official mode generates vision/frame artifacts; UI-only mode omits them
Python socket denial is defense-in-depth, not OS isolation
families n=2; 30 cells and 30 mode/repeat comparisons are nested technical evidence
no task outcome, TREE/TYPED behavior, model or ARGO efficacy
stopping_rule: one approved 30-cell run; completed parity mismatch is scientific FAIL; invalid/timeout/drift/unreaped/write-error is INVALID or INCOMPLETE; no retry/resume/repair

candidate_binding.selection_reason: mirror official render state mutations before renderJSON while excluding only graphical render/base64/PNG work
candidate_binding.official_sentinel_tests: 4/4 PASS against pinned official method on isolated actual UserInterface fixtures

timing: immediately after returned UI and api.taskProgress/api.steps update
state_fingerprint_contract.canonicalization: UTF-8 JSON, ensure_ascii=false, sorted keys, separators comma/colon, allow_nan=false, SHA-256
state_fingerprint_contract.expected_counters: observation indices 0..1000 correspond world_counter/api_steps 1..1001; controlled delta 1000

sentinel_contract.source: actual pinned DiscoveryWorldAPI.getAgentObservation and actual UserInterface.render/renderJSON on isolated fake worlds
cases: queue size 2 with two sequential reads
dialog plus queue with two sequential reads
required: official and adapter returned ui exact after each read
official returns both vision keys and two frame paths in fixed no-tick fixture
adapter returns no vision key and zero frames

mismatch_interpretation: Any cross-mode mismatch yields PARITY_NOT_ESTABLISHED / ADAPTER_NOT_ADMITTED. It does not identify adapter causality because independent processes may differ through upstream unseeded state.

controller_binding.sandbox_policy: deny-default; child writes only per-cell ephemeral workdir; no network permission; Python socket block is defense in depth

task_specific_os_isolation: sandbox-exec deny-default profile generated per cell; static denial test passed; DiscoveryWorld cell execution remains approval-gated
